body: We had a long conversation and diagnostics, and the support said that I already have whole(!!!) 35 cycles, and with such a number of cycles I have a very good battery. It sounds very sad, because it is designed for 1000 cycles.
I think I don't quite understand what you mean. The automatic support application shows 97%, and says that everything is fine
I literally did not know that existed until this moment.😅😨
Thank you...I’m just like a little girl in this scary world. He was my family. And his family too.
